notes: **Item F1: the Fig. 1 caption**, checked against the figure image (`08_USED_creating_figures/Figure_1/Fig1.png`). The caption is correct; this item trims it and fixes four small things.

**Panel b (season labels):** the x-axis of panel b reads "2019, 2020, 2021", while the caption and the whole paper say "2019–20 … 2021–22". The caption now says the seasons are "labeled by their first year". The alternative is to relabel the axis in `make_figure_1.R`, which is a figure change; see Q1.

**Panel a:** "season + block, genotype × environment" becomes "season-and-block, genotype-by-season (G×E)", the terms the Results and M&M use. The legend itself reads "Season & Block" and "G x E", which is close enough.

**Panels c and d:** each now says what the correlations are computed from, with n (accession BLUPs, n = 290; site-mean BLUPs across the 29 sites). Panel c is phrased more simply ("among the four nutritional traits (lower triangle) and between them and four morphological traits"). The outlined cells in d are stated in five words.

**Trimmed:** "with values in all three seasons" (every highlighted line has all three points), "between seasons" after "crossover", and the long significance clause. The significance clause keeps its meaning: two-sided, not corrected (your S0 answer, option A). The four highlighted accessions are still all named.
Length: unchanged (144 words): the two additions (n, season labels) take up what the trim saves. TAG style is kept: bold "Fig. 1", bold panel letters, no final period.
questions: **Season labels in panel b:** keep the caption fix (default), or ask the figure session to relabel the axis "2019–20, 2020–21, 2021–22" (then the clause "labeled by their first year" goes)?

edits.why: Terms as in the text; n for c and d; season-label mismatch explained; trimmed.
